items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public beta or go-live; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that adds no new data collection, sharing, monetization, or cross-site behavior. Woot API documentation proves access but not redistribution rights, while current Woot terms restrict commercial/public use of listings, descriptions, prices, and derivatives. Fleet compliance is not clearance: 36 sites pass, 19 fail, and 6 are unknown; operations and security sweeps have no results. Keep SearchWoot private, leave rights outreach unsent pending human counsel and owner authorization, and do not make revenue, ROI, margin, accuracy, or causal-lift claims from the aggregate $4.92 commission. The next evidence action is one dated read-only bundle covering rights, data flow/retention, consent/GA4 configuration, logs/vendors, and incident handling.

Conditional legal clearance applies only to bounded reversible work that preserves existing consent, privacy/cookie disclosures, affiliate disclosures, destinations, tracking IDs, provenance, and claims boundaries. The queued allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement may proceed only after capacity release and only if it changes no data collection, monetization terms, affiliate destination, or disclosure meaning. Do not admit the driveford.net preview as public or monetized; a non-public preview shell remains evidence-needed pending a launch-readiness artifact.
